title: fix(auth): prevent stuck loading screen when Firestore fetch fails
body:
## Summary
Fixes the app getting stuck on the "ተጠቃሚ በመጫን ላይ..." (Loading user...) screen on startup.

**Root cause:** `_loadDevUser` in `auth_gate.dart` had no `try-catch` around the `getAppUser(uid)` Firestore call. If the call threw (network error, Firestore failure, expired auth token, etc.), `_devUserLoading` remained `true` forever, leaving the app frozen on the loading screen.

**Changes:**
1. Wrapped the `getAppUser` call in a `try-catch` so that on failure, `_devUserLoading` is reset to `false` and `_devUser` is set to `null` — allowing the app to proceed instead of freezing.
2. Deferred `_loadDevUser` via `addPostFrameCallback` to avoid calling `setState` during `build()`, which is a Flutter anti-pattern.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human
- [ ] Open the app with no network / airplane mode — verify it no longer freezes on "ተጠቃሚ በመጫን ላይ..." and proceeds to the login or area selection screen
- [ ] Sign in as a developer (Google Sign-In) — verify normal flow still works
- [ ] Sign in as a member (phone+code) — verify normal flow still works
- [ ] Clear app data and reopen — verify the login screen appears without delay

### Notes
The fix is scoped to a single file (`auth_gate.dart`) with minimal, targeted changes. No new dependencies or behavioral changes beyond the error-recovery path.
